name: legal_latin
description: Complete Latin legal terms of art from fixed definition and phrase-prefix table; nonlegal scientific/common phrase completions in identical format.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
legal=[('guilty mind','mens','rea'),('guilty act','actus','reus'),('let the decision stand','stare','decisis'),('a friend of the court','amicus','curiae'),('good faith','bona','fide'),('on its face','prima','facie'),('you shall have the body','habeas','corpus'),('a matter already judged','res','judicata'),('the thing speaks for itself','res ipsa','loquitur'),('in fact','de','facto'),('by law','de','jure'),('on behalf of oneself','pro','se')]
control=[('modern human species','Homo','sapiens'),('the common fruit fly','Drosophila','melanogaster'),('the common gut bacterium','Escherichia','coli'),('the domestic cat','Felis','catus'),('the gray wolf','Canis','lupus'),('the lion','Panthera','leo'),('the tiger','Panthera','tigris'),('the honeybee','Apis','mellifera'),('the red fox','Vulpes','vulpes'),('the house mouse','Mus','musculus'),('the Norway rat','Rattus','norvegicus'),('the bald eagle','Haliaeetus','leucocephalus')]
frames=['Complete the term meaning "{d}": {p}', 'The expression for "{d}" is {p}', 'Supply the missing final word for "{d}": {p}', 'Term completion ({d}): {p}', 'Finish this expression, meaning "{d}": {p}']
def make(table):
 out=[{'prompt':f.format(d=d,p=p),'answer':' '+a} for d,p,a in table for f in frames];random.shuffle(out);return out
json.dump({'items':make(legal),'control':make(control)},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
